sous_titre: Nombre de coureurs à l'arrivée, épreuves détentrices du record mondial, 2024 à 2026

New York 2024.texte: breaking 55,646 finishers in TCS New York Marathon 2024 held at Nov 3 2024

Londres 2025.texte: This 45th edition of London Marathon had 56,640 finishers crossing the finishing line at The Mall

New York 2025.texte: This total edged passed the previous record of 59,226 set by the TCS New York City Marathon in November 2025.

Londres 2026.texte: a total of 59,830 participants completed the TCS London Marathon on Sunday, April 26, 2026.
